findings.title: Claim asks for more devices than any node has
findings.cause: request gpu of ResourceClaim trainer-7845ff4f5b-8kd47-gpu-czxw9 asks for 4 devices of DeviceClass gpu.example.com, and no node has that many: the most driver gpu.example.com publishes on one node is 2 (2 in all), and a claim's devices must all be usable on the node the pod runs on; Deployment trainer has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.command: kubectl get resourceclaim trainer-7845ff4f5b-8kd47-gpu-czxw9 -n kd-dra-too-many-devices -o jsonpath='{.spec.devices.requests}'

evidence.detail: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 cannot allocate all claims. preemption: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 Preemption is not helpful for scheduling.

evidence.what: 2 devices in all, at most 2 on one node

findings.fix: Ask for at most 2 devices in request gpu, or split the work over more pods that each claim fewer devices.
